title: Mailer box
summary: die-cut blank, staged fold, crease DXF
description: A FEFCO 0427 mailer of single-wall E-flute kraft board, 200 × 150 × 60 mm inside, folded from its die-cut blank: rolled end walls locked by tabs, dust flaps and a tuck-in lid.
process: Cut and crease on a die cutter or cutting plotter, folded by hand

difficulty.rationale: Eighteen thick-panel creases driven by a table-staged choreography of coupled formulas, a closed-form area of a 66-vertex blank, a hidden second fold for the closed proofs, collision limits to navigate.

materials: Corrugated board, single wall, E flute (1.6 mm), kraft liners, 340 g/m²

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: document.check ok with its own 12 assertions, also at 22 fold amounts and nine sizes; inside, outside, clear spaces and 19 panels equal to this example's; blank area 0.1622 m2 (+0.56 %, within 1 %); 291 steps, about 340 commands. It showed the prompt's '45 deg' for the back wall's corners could not hold (now corrected).
